props.name: label
props.description: Always required: it is the label that animates.

props.name: animateFrom
props.description: Edge the label grows from. Match it to the FAB's own corner.

props.name: duration
props.description: Animation duration (ms).

props.name: extended
props.description:
`true` shows the label, `false` collapses to the icon. Drive it from a
scroll offset to get the M3 "shrink on scroll" behaviour.

props.name: iconMode
props.description:
`static` keeps the icon put and slides the label out beside it.
`dynamic` lets the icon travel with the label as the pill grows.

props.name: placement
props.description: `inline` drops the absolute positioning (toolbar, card action row).

props.name: back
props.description: Truthy when a back destination exists (native-stack passes { title, href })

props.name: ratio
props.description: Width divided by height — `16 / 9`, `1`, `4 / 3`. Defaults to `1`.

props.name: value
props.description: The text in the field. Free text is allowed — this is not a Select.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Adds a clear button once there is text. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown when nothing matches. Omit to hide the list instead.

props.name: filter
props.description:
Custom matcher. Defaults to a case- and accent-insensitive substring test
over `label`. Pass `() => true` when the options are filtered server-side.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the field; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner in the field — for options still being fetched.

props.name: maxSuggestions
props.description: Caps the visible suggestions. Defaults to 8.

props.name: minChars
props.description: Characters required before suggestions appear. Defaults to 1.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shape: full circle, rounded corners, or square.

props.name: max
props.description: Cap shown as "max+" when count exceeds it.

props.name: showZero
props.description: Render the badge even when count is 0 (hidden by default).

props.name: actions
props.description: Up to two actions, rendered right-aligned below the message.

props.name: dismissable
props.description: Show a close (X) button; requires onDismiss.

props.name: maxHeightRatio
props.description: Max sheet height as a fraction of the window height.

props.name: bg
props.description: Background — an M3 color role name or a raw color.

props.name: m
props.description: Margin on every edge.

props.name: p
props.description: Padding on every edge.

props.name: px
props.description: Horizontal padding.

props.name: py
props.description: Vertical padding.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius — a shape token name or a raw radius.

props.name: row
props.description: Lays children out horizontally instead of vertically.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Collapse middle items behind an ellipsis when exceeding this count.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch to fill the parent width.

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Icon side relative to the label.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour role. `error` is the destructive treatment (delete, discard).

props.name: dates
props.description: Selected days in `multiple` mode.

props.name: endYear
props.description: Last year reachable from the year grid and the endless scroller.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Defaults to the locale's own week start.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Excludes days `validRange` cannot express (weekends, computed holidays).

props.name: keyboardNavigation
props.description:
Arrow-key/PageUp/Home/Enter navigation. Web only — there is no key event
source on native. Default `true`.

props.name: locale
props.description: Formatting/labelling locale. Defaults to the device locale.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires in `single` mode.

props.name: onDatesChange
props.description: Fires in `multiple` mode with the full set after the tap.

props.name: onRangeChange
props.description: Fires in `range` mode with the interval after the tap.

props.name: onRequestClose
props.description: Called on Escape while keyboard navigation is active.

props.name: range
props.description: Selected interval in `range` mode.

props.name: scrollMode
props.description:
`endless` scrolls through months in one virtualized list; `paged` shows one
month at a time behind the chevrons. Defaults to `endless`.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: How many days the grid collects. Defaults to `"single"`.

props.name: showToday
props.description: Renders the "Today" shortcut row. Default `true`.

props.name: startYear
props.description: First year reachable from the year grid and the endless scroller.

props.name: validRange
props.description: The selectable window plus individual excluded days.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected day in `single` mode.

props.name: align
props.description: Where the buttons sit on the row. M3 puts card actions on the right.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alternative text — an unnamed image is invisible to a screen reader.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Width divided by height. M3 card covers default to 16:9.

props.name: left
props.description: Leading slot — an `Avatar`, an `Icon`, a `StatusBadge`.

props.name: right
props.description: Trailing slot — an `IconButton`, a `Menu` anchor, a `Chip`.

props.name: autoPlayInterval
props.description: Auto-advance interval in ms; 0 disables auto-play.

props.name: height
props.description: Fixed height; otherwise sized by the tallest page.

props.name: showArrows
props.description: Overlay prev/next arrow buttons.

props.name: size

props.name: hours

props.name: isTimeDisabled

props.name: minuteInterval
props.description: Minute granularity the dial snaps to. Defaults to 1.

props.name: onUnitComplete
props.description: Fires when a press on the hour dial ends, to hand over to the minutes.

props.name: use24HourClock
props.description: Renders two rings (1–12 outer, 13–00 inner) instead of one.

props.name: inputType
props.description: `picker` shows the dial, `keyboard` two text fields. Defaults to `picker`.

props.name: locale
props.description: Formatting locale; decides 12h vs 24h. Defaults to the device locale.

props.name: maximumDate
props.description: Clamps the selectable times on the maximum's own day.

props.name: minimumDate
props.description: Clamps the selectable times on the minimum's own day.

props.name: minuteInterval
props.description: Minute granularity. Defaults to 1.

props.name: use24HourClock
props.description: Forces the 24-hour face. Left unset, the locale decides.

props.name: animateOpacity

props.name: collapsedHeight

props.description: Transition length in ms. Defaults to 200.

props.description: Skips unmounting the children while collapsed. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: emptyMessage
